ecosystem.notes: measure is total GPV ($259.631B), which includes Cash App GPV. Square GPV alone is stated only rounded, as $250 billion, and is recorded in squareGPV, a schema extension. GPV excludes BNPL transactions. In FY2025 Block replaced its old revenue categories (transaction-based, subscription and services-based, hardware, bitcoin) with Commerce Enablement, Financial Solutions and Bitcoin Ecosystem, so transaction-based revenue is no longer reported. platformRevenue is therefore Commerce enablement revenue ($11.514B), the category that holds Square payment fees; it also includes software, hardware, Cash App Card, Cash App Pay, BNPL, Cash App Business and TIDAL revenue, so platformRevenue ÷ GPV overstates the take on payments alone and is not comparable with the FY2024 figure. Total net revenue was $24.194B, including $8.503B of bitcoin ecosystem revenue recorded gross. Revenue is reported in thousands and GPV in millions; both are converted to billions here.
